passed_checks.check_name: Ensure KMS key policy does not contain wildcard (*) principal
code_block:
KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: CreateKmsKey
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: SSE-KMS key for S3 user uploads
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: key-default-1
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowUseOfKeyForS3InThisAccount
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub s3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
                kms:CallerAccount: !Sub ${AWS::AccountId}
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref Application
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

passed_checks.check_name: Ensure S3 bucket has block public ACLs enabled
code_block:
UploadBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !If [UseProvidedBucketName, !Ref BucketName, !Ref AWS::NoValue]
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !If [UseProvidedKmsKey, !Ref KmsKeyArn, !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn]
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: AbortIncompleteMultipartUploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
          - Id: NoncurrentVersionLifecycle
            Status: Enabled
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 180
              NewerNoncurrentVersions: 10
      CorsConfiguration: !If
        - UseCors
        - CorsRules:
            - AllowedMethods: [GET, PUT, POST, HEAD]
              AllowedOrigins: !Split [",", !Ref AllowedCorsOrigins]
              AllowedHeaders: ["*"]
              ExposedHeaders: ["ETag", "x-amz-request-id", "x-amz-version-id"]
              MaxAge: 3600
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref Application
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
